article.content: Harry Kane became the first Englishman to win football’s most prestigious individual trophy in 25 years at a lavish ceremony in London. The Bayern Munich striker followed in Michael Owen's footsteps after finishing ahead of co-favourites Lamine Yamal of Barcelona and Kylian Mbappé of Real Madrid.
